best_idea: Run recurring event windows (invasions, siege hours) from absolute epoch times stored per zone, with a restart catch-up that skips missed whole periods, and show the same countdown the scheduler uses.
decision_why: The window shape is right for zone invasions, but Frankendom keeps the window as zone data read by one zone scheduler on the server tick, with one clock, not one timer object per base.
acceptance: On the zone map a banner shows 'Invasion in 1 d 4 h 12 min'; during the window it shows 'Invasion: 2 h 40 min left'. A server test restarts the server 90 minutes into a window and asserts the same end time, one open window, no second invasion wave, and that after close the countdown equals next start minus now.
